source: V. G. Turaev, Multiplace generalizations of the Seifert form of a classical knot, Math. USSR-Sbornik 44:3 (1983) 335-361 (mathnet.ru paper id sm2474), p. 341-342
status: VERIFIED (read from rendered page image of the English translation, p. 341)
convention: V[i][j] = l_1(A)(x_i, x_j), x_1..x_6 the loops of Figure 3 with n=3; V is the Seifert matrix of A(p,q,r,s); r and s do NOT enter V (they are l_2 data)

verified_identities.alt = X^T - X: symplectic standard form pairing (1,2),(3,4),(5,6), det = 1 (so X is realizable as a Seifert matrix; VERIFIED by sympy)
verified_identities.det(X - t X^T): t^3 * rho(t) * rho(1/t) with rho(t) = p t^3 - (p+q) t^2 - (p-q+1) t + p  -- VERIFIED symbolically; matches paper's stated Alexander polynomial
verified_identities.X restricted to span(x1,x3,x5) = 0 and t: VERIFIED symbolically; both are unimodular half-rank direct summands, so the Seifert form is hyperbolic over Z
